verdict.rationale: The core Semgrep CLI/engine is open source and runs entirely locally, analyzing code on the user's machine without uploading it, confirmed by both docs and a hands-on probe running scans offline without login (semgrep-gh-2, semgrep-probe-5, semgrep-probe-7). However, there's no explicit documentation of self-hosting the full AppSec Platform (dashboards, findings storage, CI orchestration) — those appear to be a hosted SaaS layer, and pricing/registration friction is noted by a community user for the Supply Chain product (semgrep-comm-12). missing for 10: official self-hosted/on-prem deployment docs (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes install) for the full platform, and confirmation that all premium products (Code, Secrets, Supply Chain) can run fully self-hosted rather than just the OSS CLI.
